_methods.joined_exact: posted.note -> proposal_id -> proposed.weighted_len -> unique draft_built row. Deterministic.
_methods.joined_format_unambiguous: join returned >1 draft_built candidate, but ALL candidates shared one format, so the format resolves even though the row does not.
_methods.hand_from_skeleton: no draft_built row existed yet (logging postdates the post); labelled by matching the copy against editorial.build_draft's skeletons.
